name: Armored Frostboar
source_text: Armored Frostboar Subsists almost entirely on a diet of frozen berries though it finds slow off-worlders equally tasty. Achievement: Advanced Husbandry -- --

name: Armored Frostwolf
source_text: Armored Frostwolf It's trained to survive the harsh climate of Frostfire Ridge, so it snuggles as if its life depended on it. Achievement: The Stablemaster -- --

name: Armored Irontusk
source_text: Armored Irontusk It is said an elekk never forgets. No wonder it despises the Iron Horde, considering the torment the orcs put the beast through. (Alliance) Vendor Garrison Trading Post Faction: Sha'tari Defense – Exalted 5,000 Gold + 5,000 Apexis Crystals

name: Armored Razorback
source_text: Armored Razorback Never…ever…EVER…let it smell bacon on you. Drop: Vengeance, Deathtalon, Terrofist, Doomroller Tanaan Jungle --

name: Irontusk
source_text: Beastlord's Irontusk One of Darmac's trained beasts, its tusks, can pierce event he hardest Iron Horde steel. Vendors: Kronnus and Tempra Warspear and Stormshield 5,000 Timewarped Badges

name: Warwolf
source_text: Beastlord's Warwolf One of Darmac's trained beasts, it was raised in a crucible of molten fire and shows no fear. Vendors: Kronnus and Tempra Warspear and Stormshield 5,000 Timewarped Badges

name: Bristling Hellboar
source_text: Bristling Hellboar The one and only source for the rare culinary ingredient: cursed bacon. Vendor: Z'tenga the Walker Tanaan Jungle Faction: The Saberstalkers – Exalted 5000 Blackfang Claw

name: Coalfist Gronnling
source_text: Coalfist Gronnling This little gronnling is well-known for smashing his way into garrison inns and making a mess of the pots and pans. Garrison Mission: Breaker Two Frostfire Ridge and --

name: Corrupted Dreadwing
source_text: Corrupted Dreadwing Bathed in the blood of demons, these corrupted Dread Ravens are significantly more aggressive, and will often kill one another if kept in confinement. Vendor: Dawn-Seeker Krisek Tanaan Jungle Faction: Order of the Awakened – Friendly 150,000 Apexis Crystals

name: Crimson Water Strider
source_text: Crimson Water Strider "Normally bugs are for bait, but how could you look into its eyes and even think that?"- Nat Pagle Vendor: Nat Pagle Garrison Fishing Shack

name: Deathtusk Felboar
source_text: Deathtusk Felboar Veterans of the battle for Outland's Hellfire Penninsula are traumatized by thoughts of these beasts to this day. Vendors: Shadow Hunter Denjai or Vindicator Krethos Tanaan Jungle Faction: Vol' jin's Headhunters- Exalted or Hand of the Prophet - Exalted

name: Domesticated Razorback
source_text: Domesticated Razorback "Domesticated" does not mean "friendly." Bring some treats. Vendor: Gazrix Gearlock/Mimi Wizzlebub Stormshield/ Warspear Fation: Steemwheedle "Preservation" Society – Exalted 5,000 Gold and 5,000 Apexis Crystals

name: Dusty Rockhide
source_text: Dusty Rockhide Ever since acquiring this mount, you have been plagued by strange fever dreams of hippety-hoppety-clippety-cloppety elekk on parade. Vendor: Vindicator Nuurem Stormshield Faction: Council of Exarchs – Exalted 5,000 Gold + 5,000 Apexis Crystals

name: Felsteel Annihilator
source_text: Felsteel Annihilator Forged deep within Hellfire Citadel by a mad blacksmith, the Felsteel Annihilator combines the metalworking knowledge of the Iron Horde with the chaotic fel energies of the Burning Legion into an unholy union of steel and flame. Drop: Archimonde Mythic Difficulty: Hellfire Citadel --

name: Frostplains Battleboar
source_text: Frostplains Battleboar If it didn't have the cool tusk ring, it would feel so silly in that outfit. Achievement: Glory of the Dungeon Hero -- --

name: Garn Nighthowl
source_text: Garn Nighthowl The garn are the most fierce predators on Draenor, and always hunt in packs. Drop: Nok-Karosh Frostfire Ridge --

name: Garn Steelmaw
source_text: Garn Steelmaw A Trainer once tried to put decorative metal in his steelmaw wolf's mouth. He had to wait three days to get it back. Drop: Invader's Forgotten Treasure Garrison Invasion --

name: Giant Coldsnout
source_text: Giant Coldsnout Its snout is not just cold but wet. Not a pleasant way to wake up. Drop: Invader's Forgotten Treasure Garrison Invasion --

name: Gorestrider Gronnling
source_text: Gorestrider Gronnling Once "befriended," a gronnling will happily carry its rider to their death. Achievement: Glory of the Draenor Raider -- --

name: Great Greytusk
source_text: Great Greytusk Sheds its tusks once a year. Is extremely shy until they grow back. Drop: Gorok Frostfire Ridge --

name: Infernal Direwolf
source_text: Infernal Direwolf A mighty wolf of Draenor, touched by the fel energies unleashed by Gul' dan in Tanaan Jungle. It has not gone completely mad…yet. Achievement: Glory of the Hellfire Raider -- --

name: Ironhoof Destroyer
source_text: Ironhoof Destroyer Blackhand is said to have personally designed the fiery armaments used on the Iron Horde's clefthoof battle mounts. Drop: Blackhand Blackrock Foundry (Mythic) --

name: Ironside Warwolf
source_text: Ironside Warwolf It has an armored spike on its tail. Scratch its belly at your own risk. Vendor: Kil' rip Horde Garrison Trading Post Faction: Laughing Skull – Exalted 5,000 Gold + 5,000 Apexis Crystals

name: Mosshide Riverwallow
source_text: Mosshide Riverwallow Aggressive and territorial, the mosshide is known for hiding in river-shore scrub and ambushing unwary passerby. Vendor: Dawn-Seeker Krek/Dawn-Seeker Alkset Stormshield/Warspear 50,000 Gold + 5,000 Apexis Crystals

name: Mudback Riverbeast
source_text: Mudback Riverbeast Special webbing that grows on the soles of the mudback's feet gives them extra traction in mud and slick terrain. Garrison Mission: It's a Boat. It's a Plane. It's…Just a Riverbeast. Garrison --

name: Pale Thorngrazer
source_text: Pale Thorngrazer This talbuk subsists completely on a diet of thistles and thorns, making its insides as tough as its outside. Vendor: Crafticus Mindbender Stormshield Faction: Wrynn's Vanguard – Exalted 5,000 Gold + 5,000 Apexis Crystals

name: Rocktusk Battleboar
source_text: Rocktusk Battleboar It's not the metal helmet that attracts mates; it's the sweet mohawk. Vendor: Trader Araanda, Trader Darakk Lunarfall, Frostwall 10,000 Gold

name: Sapphire Riverbeast
source_text: Sapphire Riverbeast This animal's color mimics the clear blue of Draenor's river shallows, making it almost invisible to aquatic predators. Drop: Silthide Talador --

name: Shadowhide Pearltusk
source_text: Shadowhide Pearltusk Some of the legends say the draenei first befriended the elekk after one of the beasts saved an injured scout from a pack of vicious podlings. Drop: Invader's Forgotten Treasure Garrison Invasion --

name: Shadowmane Charger
source_text: Shadowmane Charger Draenei poets have likened this talbuk's coloring to shadows cast by moonlight in an ashen forest. Vendor: Ravenspeaker Skeega/ Shadow-Sage Brakoss Stormshield/Warspear 5,000 Gold + 5,000 Apexis Crystals

name: Smoky Direwolf
source_text: Smoky Direwolf Believed to reside mostly in the north. Hates weddings. Drop: Invader's Forgotten Treasure Garrison Invasion --

name: Soaring Skyterror
source_text: Soaring Skyterror The extra-light equipment on this chromatic rylak allows it to swoop and glide through the clouds easily, free from the bounds of the land below. Achievement: Draenor Pathfinder -- --

name: Solar Spirehawk
source_text: Solar Spirehawk Looking into the eyes of this mystical beast is like peering into the heart of the sun. Goggles are recommended when you're riding. Drop: Rukhmar Spires of Arak

name: Sunhide Gronnling
source_text: Sunhide Gronnling Loves the sun, hates everything else. Drop: Poundfist Gorgrond --

name: Swift Breezestrider
source_text: Swift Breezestrider Draenei have relied on this mount, the swiftest of all talbuk, to relay messengers and their missives safely to their destinations. Drop: Pathrunner Shadowmoon Valley --

name: Swift Frostwolf
source_text: Swift Frostwolf Amidst the cold heights of Frostfire, the frostwolves hunt anything they can catch. The fastest among them eat well. (Horde Only) Vendor: Beska Redtusk Warspear Faction: Frostwolf Orcs – Exalted 5,000 Gold and 5,000 Apexis Crystals

name: Trained Icehoof
source_text: Trained Icehoof It wasn't until you owned this mount that you understood how much of the world of Draenor would test you. Clefthoof hair gets in everything! Garrison Stables Garrison --

name: Trained Meadowstomper
source_text: Trained Meadowstomper The draenei perfected elekk husbandry long ago, adorning the creatures with Light-infused crystals to make them more docile. Quest: Garrison Stables Garrison --

name: Trained Riverwallow
source_text: Trained Riverwallow Riverwallows are one of the heartiest beasts on Draenor, resulting in their increased stamina and distinctive coloring. Quest: Garrison Stables Garrison --

name: Trained Rocktusk
source_text: Trained Rocktusk Thoroughly trained in how to snort, trot, and stomp on the faces of its enemies. Quest: Garrison Stables Garrison

name: Trained Silverpelt
source_text: Trained Silverpelt Prized for its intelligence, this breed of talbuk can be trained to execute defensive kicks and gorings in battle. Garrison Stables Garrison

name: Trained Snarler
source_text: Trained Snarler Enormously cute as a puppy. Slightly less so now. Quest: Garrison Stables Garrison --

name: Tundra Icehoof
source_text: Tundra Icehoof A translucent layer of down hair covers this breed's leathery hide, acting as the perfect insulation for cold environments. Drop: Vengeance, Deathtalon, Terrofist, Doomroller Tanaan Jungle --

name: Voidtalon of the Dark Star
source_text: Voidtalon of the Dark Star Corrupted by the presence of the Dark Star in Draenor, the Voidtalons resisted being broken by the Shadowmoon Clan and were ultimately destroyed by Ner'zhul. Only a single egg remains, lost in the void. Drop: Voidtalon Egg Nagrand, Shadowmoon Valley, Frostfire Ridge, Gorgrond, Talador --

name: Warsong Direfang
source_text: Warsong Direfang Has a will of iron but is a sweetheart if you give it a clefthoof bone to chew on. Drop: Vengeance, Deathtalon, Terrorfist, Doomroller Tanaan Jungle --

name: Wild Goretusk
source_text: Wild Goretusk If you want a gentle ride, go find a "tame happytusk" or something. Vendor: Z'Tenga the Walker Tanaan Jungle Faction: The Saberstalkers - Honored 1000 Blackfang Claws

name: Witherhide Cliffstomper
source_text: Witherhide Cliffstomper Tiny notches cover the hooves of this variation of clefthoof, allowing it to safely scale mountainous regions in search of food. Vendor: Trader Araanda, Trader Darakk Garrison 20,000 Gold

name: Albino Chimaeraling
source_text: Albino Chimaeraling "Both heads are equally fearsome on the terrifying chimaera, each capable of its own unique breath attack." Quest: Mastering the Menagerie Lunarfall, Frostwall --

name: Albino River Calf
source_text: Albino River Calf "Their white hide would make them vulnerable to sunburn if it wasn't as thick as plate armor." Vendor: Mimi Wizzlebub, Gazrix Gearlock Warspear, Stormshield Faction: Steamwheedle Preservation Society – Revered 1,000 Gold

name: Blazing Firehawk
source_text: Blazing Firehawk "Arakkoa sun worship has resulted in the creation of some strange and monstrous minions." Vendor: Dawn-Seeker Krisek Tanaan Jungle Faction: Order of the Awakened – Exalted 2,000 Apexis Crystals

name: Bloodbeak
source_text: Bloodbeak "The ancient tribes of Draenor were known to harvest their sharp beaks for crude tools and weapons." Pet Battle Tanaan Jungle --

name: Bloodthorn Hatchling
source_text: Bloodthorn Hatchling "Ravagers are favored ogre snacks when they are small and less deadly." Vendor: Tiffy Trapsring, Giada Goldleash Garrison 50 Shiny Pet Charms

name: Bone Serpent
source_text: Bone Serpent "Young bone serpents will try to burrow into a living creature's skull and devour their brain. So, you may want to wear a night cap." Pet Battle: Erris the Collector, Kura Thunderhoof Garrison --

name: Bone Wasp
source_text: Bone Wasp "One ogre ritual involves cupping a bone wasp in their hands and shaking vigorously. The venom increases strength and invokes vivid imagery." Vendor: Kil' rip Frostwall Faction: Laughing Skull – Revered 1,000 Gold,

name: Cerulean Moth
source_text: Cerulean Moth "Delicate and dangerous, brilliant and bold, a beauty worth more than gold." Pet Battle Tanaan Jungle --

name: Cinder Pup
source_text: Cinder Pup "Found munching on blackened bone in the Black Forge of Blackrock Foundry, this pup really seems to warm up to you quickly." Garrison Mission: Fiery Friends Garrison --

name: Corrupted Nest Guardian
source_text: Corrupted Nest Guardian "There is very little difference between a corrupted nest guardian and an omelette chef." Drop: Shadow-Lord Iskar Hellfire Citadel

name: Crazy Carrot
source_text: Crazy Carrot "Left to their own devices, carrots will simply lose their minds." Vendor: Naron Bloomthistle, Tarnon Lunarfall, Frostwall 1,000 Draenic Seeds

name: Crusher
source_text: Crusher "Found wandering in a small blizzard, this lost goren carries a mining pick to show that he is a jack of all trades." Vendor: Trader Araanda, Trader Darakk Lunarfall, Frostwall 1,000 Gold

name: Draenei Micro Defender
source_text: Draenei Micro Defender "While these tiny mechanical guardians were created to protect domesticated elekks from pests, they also turned out to be really good at giving back massages." Vendor: Vindicator Nuurum Stormshield Faction: Council of Exarchs - Revered 250 Gold

name: Dusty Sporewing
source_text: Dusty Sporewing "Their wings emit a fine powder as a defensive mechanism when it is in danger." Vendor: Tiffy Trapspring, Giada Goldleash Garrison 50 Shiny Pet Charms

name: Everbloom Peachick
source_text: Everbloom Peachick "These tiny creatures seem to favor big, fluffy nests, preferably atop an animal-loving dryad." Quest: For The Birds The Everbloom --

name: Fel Flame
source_text: Fel Flame "Born from demonic magic, these petulant little entities corrupt everything they touch with foul energies." Pet Battle Shadowmoon Valley, Tanaan Jungle --

name: Fel Pup
source_text: Fel Pup "These pops are bundles of fur and teeth until they grow up, at which point they are really just teeth." Quest: A Fel Puppy of My Own Tanaan Jungle --

name: Fen Crab
source_text: Fen Crab "These crafty crustaceans burrow under the mud to avoid being scooped up by larger predators." Pet Battle Tanaan Jungle --

name: Fire-Proof Roach
source_text: Fire-Proof Roach "The outer member of the roaches' eggs protect the larva from incineration. It is here in incubation that they gain the ability to resist the fire and heat of the volcanic climate." Pet Battle Frostfire Ridge, Mount Hyjal --

name: Firewing
source_text: Firewing "Don't line her cage with paper unless you want a fire." Quest: Mastering the Menagerie Garrison --

name: Forest Sproutling
source_text: Forest Sproutling "From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown." Vendor: Kwilax Fuseshiv Warspear, Stormshield Faction: Steamwheedle Preservation Society – Revered 1000 Gold

name: Frostfur Rat
source_text: Frostfur Rat "Annoying and destructive, they can be coaxed with enough cheese to become a tolerable companion." Pet Battle Frostfire Ridge --

name: Frostshell Pincher
source_text: Frostshell Pincher "The frostshell pinchers build up layers of ice to give them the extra protection from larger predators." Pet Battle Frostfire Ridge --

name: Frostwolf Pup
source_text: Frostwolf Pup "These pups are bundles of fur and teeth until they grow up, at which point they are really just teeth." Vendor: Beska Redtusk Warspear Faction: Frostwolf Orcs – Revered

name: Fruit Hunter
source_text: Fruit Hunter "This anxious avian has a voracious appetite for fruit." Drop: Wiggling Egg Frostfire Ridge --

name: Glowing Sporebat
source_text: Glowing Sporebat "Wild sporebats are vicious creatures, but if tamed at a young age, they can be loyal companions." Vendor: Tiffy Trapspring, Giada Goldleash Garrison 100 Shiny Pet Charms

name: Horny Toad
source_text: Horny Toad "There are many scholars who question whether it is a toad or not." Pet Battle Desolace, Tanaan Jungle --

name: Icespine Hatchling
source_text: Icespine Hatchling "Equipped with extremely sharp claws, these frigid hatchlings dig through thick layers of ice and rock for shelter." Pet Battle Frostfire Ridge --

name: Ironclaw Scuttler
source_text: Ironclaw Scuttler "With claws that can crush a platemail gauntlet, it's best to handle with care." Pet Battle Frostfire Ridge --

name: Land Shark
source_text: Land Shark "After birth, newborn sharks quickly flee their hungry mothers. Their early independence makes them dangerous even while young." Profession: Fishing Garrison, Fishing Shack Nat Pagle- Good Friends 50 Nat's Lucky Coin

name: Left Shark
source_text: Left Shark "Who would leave such a cute shark behind? The Iron Horde truly has no soul." Garrison Mission: Orphaned Aquatic Animal Rescue Garrison --

name: Lost Netherpup
source_text: Lost Netherpup "Rumor has it that some beasts that were touched by the void exist in a space between this world and the next." Vendor: Tiffy Trapspring, Giada Goldleash Garrison 200 Shiny Pet Charms

name: Nightmare Bell
source_text: Nightmare Bell "Once a holy artifact used by draenei priests to calm spirits, it has become animated by anguished souls and drawn to locations of death and corruption." Drop: Fel-Touched Pet Supplies Tanaan Jungle --

name: Nightshade Sproutling
source_text: Nightshade Sproutling "From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown." Profession: Warlords of Draenor Herbalism Draenor --

name: Ore Eater
source_text: Ore Eater "They eat and eat and eat until they grow large. Then they eat some more." Profession: Warlords of Draenor Mining Draenor --

name: Periwinkle Calf
source_text: Periwinkle Calf "These playful little riverbeasts enjoy scooping up a large mouthful of water and then spitting it at one another." Drop: Fel-Touched Pet Supplies Tanaan Jungle --

name: Puddle Terror
source_text: Puddle Terror "Living so closely to the water's surface, the puddle terror is not only friend to all aquatic creatures, it is one." Quest: Mastering the Menagerie Garrison --

name: Pygmy Cow
source_text: Pygmy Cow "Originally bred to make milk more palatable for gnomes." Drop: Garrison, Barn, Level 3 Garrison --

name: Savage Cub
source_text: Savage Cub "Pets often look a lot like their owners, which is especially true if the owner was a saberon." Vendor: Z'tenga the Walker Tanaan Jungle Faction: The Saberstalkers – Revered 1,500 Blackfang Claws

name: Seaborne Spore
source_text: Seaborne Spore "A spore from Zangarra, a central area of the Zangar encroachment that would later bloom into the Zagarmarsh." Drop: Fel-Touched Pet Supplies Tanaan Jungle --

name: Sea Gull
source_text: Sea Gull "The seagull is a coastal scavenger often found near the docks." Pet Battle Frostwall, Krasarang Wilds, Talador, Tanaris --

name: Companion
source_text: Sentinel's Companion "The companion of a night elf sentinel, rarely given out as a gift." Quest: The Huntresses Shadowmoon Valley --

name: Shard of Cyrukh
source_text: Shard of Cyrukh "A small amount of Cyrukh burns everlasting within this portion of the Cipher. Best keep it close to you." Drop: Forgotten Shard of the Cipher Tanaan Jungle --

name: Slithershock Elver
source_text: Slithershock Elver "The rivers of Draenor are filled with moray. They are vicious predators, attacking anything that enters the water." Pet Battle: Erris the Collector, Kura Thunderhoof Garrison --

name: Son of Sethe
source_text: Son of Sethe "Godlike being now in travel size." Vendor: Ravenspeaker Skeega, Shadow-Sage Brakoss Warspear, Stormshield Faction: Arakkoa Outcasts- Revered 1,000 Gold

name: Sun Sproutling
source_text: Sun Sproutling "From seed to flower, a tiny terror is grown." Quest: Mastering the Menagerie Garrison --

name: Sunfire Kaliri
source_text: Sunfire Kaliri "Legend says the Sunfire Kaliri flies into the sun itself when it is ready to die." Quest: Mastering the Menagerie Garrison --

name: Tree Python
source_text: Tree Python "Stranglethorn's Gurubashi trolls often capture these powerful beasts to keep as pets…or to cook as meals." Pet Battle Northern Stranglethorn, Tanaan Jungle, The Cape of Stranglethorn, Un'Goro Crater --

name: Twilight Wasp
source_text: Twilight Wasp "In the moonlight, their wings create a glittering aura, giving the illusion of twinkling starlight." Pet Battle Frostfire Ridge, Gorgrond --

name: Violet Firefly
source_text: Violet Firefly "These fireflies retain their purple glow by eating only purple flowers and nectar." Pet Battle Tanaan Jungle --

name: Waterfly
source_text: Waterfly "The waterfly uses the surface of the water to reflect the light from their abdomen to attract mates." Pet Battle Shadowmoon Valley, Talador, Tanaan Jungle --

name: Weebomination
source_text: Weebomination "Made from bits and pieces of vanquished battle pets, dark magic, and just a pinch of love." Quest: Mastering the Menagerie Garrison --

name: Young Talbuk
source_text: Young Talbuk "Talbuk grow their horns to full size at an early age." Pet Battle: Erris the Collector, Kura Thunderhoof Garrison --

name: Zangar Spore
source_text: Zangar Spore "In Draenor, the Zangar Sea Seeks to overtake the land by releasing thousands of these spores and slowly growing inland over time." Drop: Fel-Touched Pet Supplies Tanaan Jungle --

name: Accursed Tome of the Sargerei
source_text: Accursed Tome of the Sargerei Follow the path of the Man'ari Eredar Treasure: Tome of Secrets Tanaan Jungle --

name: Alliance Flag of Victory
source_text: Alliance Flag of Victory Place a flag on an enemy player's corpse in front of you. (Alliance Only) Garrison Building: Gladiator's Sanctum -- --

name: Bloom
source_text: Ancient's Bloom Make like a tree and leaf. Drop: Yggdrel Shadowmoon Valley --

name: Angry Beehive
source_text: Angry Beehive Shake me. Treasure: Swamplighter Hive Shadowmoon Valley --

name: Apexis Focusing Shard
source_text: Apexis Focusing Shard Some luminous latent power still lingers in this splinter of an Apexis shard. Timewalking Vendor: Kronnus, Tempra Warspear, Stormshield 500 Timewarped Badges

name: Archmage Vargoth's Spare Staff
source_text: Archmage Vargoth's Spare Staff Attempt to contact Archmage Vargoth. "Although the staff shows no visible signs of age, you get the impression that it is lost in time and space." Quest: Finding Farahlon Garrison --

name: Arena Master's War Horn
source_text: Arena Master's War Horn Summon ogre gladiators to battle for your entertainment. "Are you not amused?" Treasure: Arena Master's War Horn Frostfire Ridge --

name: Autographed Hearthstone Card
source_text: Autographed Hearthstone Card Turn the card over to see what you got! "Signed by Trump and Reckful. Not too shabby." Garrison Mission -- --

name: Feather
source_text: Aviana's Feather Launches you high into the air and deploys magical wings. Can only be used in Draenor. "Holding the feather makes you yearn to swoop through the open skies of Draenor." Quest: Aviana's Request Garrison Inn --

name: Bountiful Bloom
source_text: Ba'ruun's Bountiful Bloom Restores 60% health and 60% Mana over 30 seconds. Must remain seated while drinking. Can only be used in Draenor. Drop: Ba'ruun Shadowmoon Valley --

name: Banner of the Burning Blade
source_text: Banner of the Burning Blade Don the banner of the Burning Blade clan. Vendor: Kronnus or Tempra Warspear or Stormshield 750 Timewarped Badges

name: Black Whirlwind
source_text: Black Whirlwind Summons a powerful whirlwind that will spin you around and launch you in a random direction. Only usable in Draenor. Drop: Soul-Twister Torek Shadowmoon Valley --

name: Blazing Diamond Pendant
source_text: Blazing Diamond Pendant Covers your feet in blazing magma. Useable only in Draenor. "Can't touch this." Quest: Diamonds Are Forever Frostfire Ridge --

name: Bloodmane Charm
source_text: Bloodmane Charm Transforms caster to have the appearance of a Bloodmane Saberon. Vendor: Smuggler Spires of Arak 500 Gold

name: Bodyguard Miniaturization Device
source_text: Bodyguard Miniaturization Device Miniaturize your Bodyguard for 1 hour. Vendor: Jonathan Stephens, Moz' def Garrison --

name: Botani Camouflage
source_text: Botani Camouflage Blend in with the Botani Drop: Basten Gorgrond --

name: Bottomless Stygana Mushroom Brew
source_text: Bottomless Stygana Mushroom Brew Restores 14,840 mana over 20 seconds. Must remain seated while drinking. Side effects may occur. Can only be consumed outdoors in Draenor Treasure: Bleeding Hollow Mushroom Stash Tanaan Jungle --

name: Breath of Talador
source_text: Breath of Talador A gust of wind propels you forward. Can only be used in Draenor. Drop: Glimmerwing Talador --

name: Bubble Wand
source_text: Bubble Wand Shoot a stream of bubbles for 5 seconds. "A child's toy, often seen at parties or in the hands of an angry water elemental." Drop: Sulfurious Gorgrond --

name: Burning Blade
source_text: Burning Blade Don the banner and weaponry of the Burning Blade. "Banner and weaponry carried by masters of the blade." Garrison Mission: Burning Blademasters Garrison --

name: Burning Legion Missive
source_text: Burning Legion Missive Eavesdrop on the Burning Legion's commands. Drop: The Burning Front Talador --

name: Thrashin' Cannon Controller
source_text: Crashin' Thrashin' Cannon Controller Summon and control your Crashin' Thrashin' Cannon. "Part of the "Iron Armada" set." Drop: Gondar Tanaan Jungle --

name: Cursed Feather of Ikzan
source_text: Cursed Feather of Ikzan Transforms the caster to have the appearance of one of Iskar's followers. Drop: High Priest Ikzan Tanaan Jungle --

name: Dazzling Rod
source_text: Dazzling Rod Equip a Dazzling Rod, allowing you to shoot arcane energy at others wielding the rod. "A game played by Draenic children." Treasure: Dazzling Rod Tanaan Jungle --

name: Smoldering Boots
source_text: Deceptia's Smoldering Boots Make your boots smolder. Treasure: Deceptia's Smoldering Boots Talador --

name: Ever-Blooming Frond
source_text: Ever-Blooming Frond Restores 15% of health and mana every 1 second for 6 seconds. Any damage taken will remove the bloom. Can only be used in Draenor. "Any tear in this leaf is instantly repaired." Quest: Cenarion Concerns Garrison Inn --

name: Felflame Campfire
source_text: Felflame Campfire Build a fel campfire that is unpleasant to be around. It does allow cooking, though. Drop: Bramblefell Tanaan Jungle --

name: Loot-A-Rang
source_text: Findle's Loot-A-Rang Retrieves the loot from a nearby corpse. Can only be used in Draenor. Profession: Engineering -- --

name: Firefury Totem
source_text: Firefury Totem Place a Firefury Totem that will set the sky on fire for 10 minutes. (Horde Only) "Flames dance playfully around the totem." Quest: Fury of Frostfire Frostfire Ridge --

name: Frostwolf Grunt's Battlegear
source_text: Frostwolf Grunt's Battlegear Garb yourself for battle as a Frostwolf soldier. (Horde Only) Vandor: Shadow Hunter Denjai Tanaan Jungle Faction: Vol' jin's Headhunters - Revered

name: Fruit Basket
source_text: Fruit Basket Throw a piece of fruit at the target, utterly destroying the fruit. Garrison Building: Inn Garrison --

name: Braid
source_text: Gamon's Braid Clutch the braid tightly, and Gamon will be with you. "Gamon will save us!" Garrison Building: Inn Garrison --

name: Ghostly Iron Buccaneer's Hat
source_text: Ghostly Iron Buccaneer's Hat Show mutineers you've got a bone to pick with them. Drop: Captain Ironbeard Tanaan Jungle --

name: Giant Deathweb Egg
source_text: Giant Deathweb Egg Shake me. Treasure: Curious Deathweb Egg Talador --

name: Goren "Log" Roller
source_text: Goren "Log" Roller Summon a goren to take you for a ride. Drop: Gibblette the Cowardly Frostfire Ridge --

name: Goren Garb
source_text: Goren Garb Disguises yourself as a goren. Treasure: Warm Goren Egg Gorgrond --

name: Hearthstone Board
source_text: Hearthstone Board Throw down a Hearthstone board, letting everyone know you're ready to play! Vendor: Benjamin Brode Garrison 1,000 Gold

name: Horde Flag of Victory
